<section class="resources-section">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="resource-grid">
      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Pinocchio Golf Model Repository</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Rigid body dynamics and kinematics models using Pinocchio for golf swing analysis. Includes 
          forward/inverse dynamics, Jacobian computations, and constraint handling for multibody systems 
          in golf biomechanics.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Overview</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          This repository implements golf swing models using Pinocchio, a fast and flexible implementation 
          of rigid body dynamics algorithms. Pinocchio provides efficient algorithms for robot dynamics and 
          kinematics, based on Roy Featherstone's "Rigid Body Dynamics Algorithms." The models enable 
          efficient computation of forward and inverse dynamics for golf swing analysis.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Features</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          <strong>Fast Dynamics:</strong> Efficient forward and inverse dynamics computation<br>
          <strong>Jacobian Computation:</strong> Tools for computing kinematic Jacobians<br>
          <strong>Constraint Handling:</strong> Support for constrained multibody systems<br>
          <strong>Analytical Derivatives:</strong> Automatic differentiation capabilities<br>
          <strong>Optimization:</strong> Integration with optimization frameworks
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Related Resources</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          This repository is closely related to the <a href="models-pinnochio.html">Pinocchio Models page</a>, 
          which includes links to Roy Featherstone's website, his classic text "Rigid Body Dynamics Algorithms," 
          and additional software resources. Pinocchio is developed by the Stack of Tasks team and is particularly 
          useful for robotics applications requiring fast dynamics computations.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
